prompt: Sarah, a Linux administrator, wants to set up an email filtering rule that processes messages only if the subject contains the word "Alert" and the email is from the domain `example.com`. Which of the following conditions would successfully match these criteria?
explanation: Option B correctly sets up two conditions. The first condition `^Subject:.*Alert` checks if the email subject contains the word "Alert", while the second condition `^From:.*@example.com` checks if the email is from the domain `example.com`. The `&&` is used to ensure both conditions are met.
